title: Dynamic Context Scheduling: Learning Beyond the Static Universe
abstract: arXiv:2608.20799v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We study dynamic context scheduling as a training instrument for contextual re- inforcement learning. Rather than treating intra-episode context variation as a deployment reality, we treat it as a controlled shaping mechanism. Thereby, context evolves within each training episode according to a predetermined schedule, expos- ing the policy to a richer and more temporally structured region of the environment parameter space. We introduce DYNAMICCARLENV, a framework that wraps contextual environments with pluggable schedule families, such as sinusoidal off- sets or cosine annealing. Across CartPole, BipedalWalker and VehicleRacing with CARL contextualization, we show that dynamic schedules match or outperform static context baselines in the out-of-distribution (OOD) regimes. Interestingly, for the more complex BipedalWalker and VehicleRacing environments we also achieve higher in-distribution (ID) evaluation performance. Preliminary findin

translated_title: 动态上下文调度：超越静态宇宙的学习
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.20799v1 公告类型：新 摘要：我们研究了动态上下文调度作为上下文强化学习的一种训练工具。我们不是将情节内上下文变化视为部署现实，而是将其视为一种受控的塑造机制。因此，上下文在每个训练情节内根据预定计划演变，使策略暴露于环境参数空间中更丰富且更具时间结构化的区域。我们引入了DYNAMICCARLENV，一个框架，该框架用可插拔的调度家族（如正弦偏移或余弦退火）包裹上下文环境。在带有CARL上下文化的CartPole、BipedalWalker和VehicleRacing环境中，我们表明动态调度在分布外（OOD）区域中匹配或优于静态上下文基线。有趣的是，对于更复杂的BipedalWalker和VehicleRacing环境，我们还实现了更高的分布内（ID）评估性能。初步发现...
tldr: 该论文提出动态上下文调度作为一种训练机制，通过情节内预定计划演变上下文，在分布外和部分分布内场景中优于静态基线，并引入DYNAMICCARLENV框架实现此方法。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes dynamic context scheduling as a training mechanism that evolves context within episodes according to predetermined plans, outperforming static baselines in OOD and some ID scenarios, and introduces the DYNAMICCARLENV framework.
